note: A deterministic, labelled demonstration fixture of the applicant help assistant. It was written for this demonstration against the published text it quotes; it is not a recording of a Muse answer and it is never presented as one.

citations.quote: 'The City needs more information' means the City could not assess your application yet. Open your application to see what is missing, then send the answer and the documents the City asked for.

answer.text: It means the City could not assess your application yet. Open your application to see what is missing, then send the answer and the documents the City asked for.

citations.quote: Answering the City: when the City needs information or asks for revisions, open your application, upload what was asked for and send the answer. Sending the answer creates a new revision, and the City assesses it again from the start.

answer.text: Sending the answer creates a new revision, and the City assesses the new revision from the start.
